dedupe_keys.name: french catalogue of nature based solution projects 2025 edition

description: This catalogue presents inspiring nature-based solution projects in France as examples for local authorities, river syndicates, associations and companies facing water, risk, health and climate adaptation challenges. It covers about thirty recent flagship projects in mainland France and the overseas territories, each distinguished by a national jury under the Plan Eau, the ecological engineering prizes, the LIFE ARTISAN adaptation trophies or the resilient coastal territories call for projects of 2019 to 2023, with project sheets that now include the public funding mobilised, a summary table pointing to other projects, and a page of practical resources. It was written by the priority projects mission of the Directorate for Water and Biodiversity in the General Directorate for Planning, Housing and Nature, and published in September 2025. It is available as a free PDF of 33 pages in French on the ministry website; no licence is stated in the document. Caveats: it is a selective showcase, not a complete register, and projects are described qualitatively. It is useful as a source of French green-blue infrastructure cases with funding information for climate adaptation and flood risk planning; a related record is the Oppla nature-based solutions repository.
